key_claims.claim: Genome-wide NIPT rare autosomal trisomies have a fetal PPV of approximately 5 percent, but about one-third of flagged pregnancies experience adverse outcomes including growth restriction, stillbirth, or preterm delivery; the theoretical mosaicism ratio does not reliably predict which pregnancies are at highest risk.
Maternal oral propranolol led to chorioangioma regression and resolution of fetal cardiac decompensation in all four treated cases without need for fetoscopic intervention.

The most common prenatal findings in KBG syndrome are fetal growth restriction and increased nuchal translucency; chromosomal microarray can detect non-coding 16q24.3 deletions that targeted sequencing may miss.
Flexible and rigid fetoscopes showed no significant difference in operator performance for simulated TTTS Solomonization across 20 operators in a crossover design.
Prenatal molecular testing for Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome yields a detection rate of approximately 10 percent, with methylation mosaicism and sample failures representing key practical limitations.
